name: Andi AI Search
summary: Web search API for agents with adjustable effort, optional full page content, a page fetch/extract endpoint and curated topic news feeds.

api_key.description: an Andi API key (console.andiai.com). Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Outcome-based pricing: each call is charged for the work it did plus a per-token rate on returned content. Every JSON response reports its cost in metrics.cost_dollars (frontmatter cost_dollars with format=context). An empty balance answers 402.
Rate limits are per key, per endpoint, per second, set in the console; responses carry X-RateLimit-* headers and 429 carries Retry-After.

endpoints.name: Search the web
endpoints.summary: Ranked web results for a query, with optional extracts or full page text.

q.description: Query; operators such as site:, filetype:, intitle: are parsed unless parseOperators=false. A JSON array of up to 5 queries runs a multi-query search.

limit.description: 1 to 100. Omitted: 10 to 40 picked to fit the query (20 with offset or multi-query).

searchMode.description: Effort: auto (default) picks per query; low-cost caps the cost.

intent.description: Force an intent (search, news, video, images, weather, wiki, code, recipe, place, time...); none disables detection.

format.description: json (default) or context (markdown for an LLM).

extracts.description: Include passages from result pages (no extra cost).

content.description: Full page text per result: true (head of page), focused (query-relevant parts) or false (default).

maxContentLength.description: Character cap of page content per result, when content is on.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 locale bias, default US.

sourceCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: only sources from this country.

language.description: Language tag such as en or zh-Hans; detected when omitted.

includeDomains.description: Comma-separated domains to restrict to; wildcards like *.example.com allowed.

excludeDomains.description: Comma-separated domains to exclude; wildcards allowed.

notes: Full content is charged per token: cap it with maxContentLength and limit. extracts are free.
POST /api/v1/search takes the same parameters as a JSON body (and location fields); not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Fetch and extract a web page
endpoints.summary: Clean title, article text and metadata of one page, as JSON or LLM-ready markdown.

effort.description: How hard to try; max helps slow or client-rendered pages.

query.description: Scope extraction to this query; adds query_extracts and query_snippet.

notes: $0.001 per request plus $0.05 per 1M tokens of content. 422 and 503 answers are free.

endpoints.name: List news feed topics
endpoints.summary: Every topic available to andi.news.feed, with formats and recent story counts.

endpoints.name: Get a curated topic news feed
endpoints.summary: Ranked recent articles for a fixed topic, optionally filtered by keyword, with an AI brief.

q.description: Keyword filter within the topic, up to 200 characters (no brief is returned with q).

hours.description: Recency window in hours, 1 to 336, default 48.

lang.description: Language code, or all. Default en.

format.description: json (default), context (markdown) or rss. embed and ticker are HTML widgets.

content.description: Include stored full article text (billed per token).

maxContentLength.description: Character cap of content per article.

notes: results are ranked by relevance; news holds the same articles newest first. Charged for ranking plus per token of content.
